record_audits.database_value: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals this sequence is most similar (92%) to scorpine Im5 L: 20%; F=S=K: 16%: 13%. GRAVY: 0.372; Mol W: 2798.4; Mol formula: C135H217N33O31; Mol Ex coeff: 0. Activity: active against P. aeruginosa DSM 50071 (MIC 12.5 ug/ml), E. coli DSM 787 (MIC 6.25 ug/ml), K. pneumoniae ATCC BAA 1705 (MIC 6.25 ug/ml), A. baumannii DSM 30008 (MIC 6.25 ug/ml), S. aureus ATCC 43300 (MIC 6.25 ug/ml), S. epidermidis DSM 28319 (MIC 6.25 ug/ml), E. faecalis MF 06036 (MIC 6.25 ug/ml), E. faecium NCTC 12201 (MIC 6.25 ug/ml), and C. difficile DSM 27147 or ATCC BAA 1382 (MIC 3.13 ug/ml). In vitro Toxicity: murine RBC: HC50 18 ug/ml, highly hemolytic.
